title: Paperclip scientists split between Redstone Arsenal and Los Alamos, linked to contact events
place_text: Redstone Arsenal, Huntsville, Alabama; Los Alamos, New Mexico

tellings.quote: the Nazis and name only were kind of settled around Redstone Arsenal and then the the true believers >> that's in Huntsville, Alabama. Yes. >> And then the true believers were uh in Los Alamos.

plain: After the Second World War, the German scientists brought to America under Operation Paperclip, the US programme that recruited them, were split into two camps, according to a guest presented as a Pentagon whistleblower named Matthew Brown. He tells Michels that those who were "Nazis in name only" settled around Redstone Arsenal, an Army base in Huntsville, Alabama, while "the true believers" went to Los Alamos, the nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico. He gives no source, and he links this split to later events he says involved contact with non-human beings.
